description: It was great to join friends and supporters in Poughkeepsie for a Flag Day celebration honoring Wayne Nussbickel. Flag Day is a reminder of the values that unite us as Americans and the freedoms our flag represents. Thank you to the City of Poughkeepsie Republican Committee for hosting a wonderful event and to everyone who came out to celebrate our nation, our flag, and the principles they represent. 🇺🇸
